text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. For the Umamusume,
it is a time for intensive training, as well as a time to refresh.
A group of Umamusume were excitedly squealing and chattering around the scale in the training lodge.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what the heck~? Why'd I gain weight?
Even though I've been working out properly~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's a growth spurt, alright! A growth spurt!
...Wait, does gaining weight from eating count as growing?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, what is thaaat~?
Narita Top Road was also among them, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Uh... um... well...

She was hesitating. I could tell at a glance
that there had to be a reason.
choice_data_list: I think it's something you should be aware of, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

Fluctuations in weight
are also an important barometer.
As Narita Top Road steps onto the scale with downcast eyes—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
choice_data_list: You noticed all along, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Class Rep is so slim~ So jealous~

"Obsessing over one's figure and fashion
is strictly for ordinary people."

More importantly, what matters for an athlete
is...
choice_data_list: It's gone down quite a bit…
It's gone down quite a bit…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Honestly, in the spring...
I couldn't keep up with all the energy I was burning at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I feel like it keeps getting chipped away, and honestly, it's still running a bit low even now...

—A war of attrition. Proof of just how fierce
the clash against T.M. Opera O
and Admire Vega truly was.

It cannot be helped. However, we cannot simply
let it end at that forever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Physical recovery is important too, so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Indeed. We cannot afford to skip training, though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to make up for it.
Heading into the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san, um... are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If you're hungry,
I can give you my popsicle.
It snaps right in half!

Rice Shower, a close friend who loves picture books,
and Haru Urara, an undaunted, energetic Umamusume,
are both worried about her too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Rice-chan, Urara-chan.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
Races, class duties...
Being class rep must be tough, as always.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"We'll cheer you on just as much to make up for it!
Just don't push yourself too hard, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much.
I'm sure it'll be fine.

Even so, the sun outside is quite harsh.
This summer... doesn't look like it's going to be very comfortable.

The scorching heat, the hot wind, the humidity...
Finding a way to skillfully endure them was the key.
